facts_verified_from_repo: No Grade 6–9 KNTT map presently has a PRIMARY roadmap reference to topic 22.
The Grade-9 overlay explicitly lists topic 22 as excluded and cautions that cross-grade audit is required before relayering.
The existing 120-question bank uses 10 skill IDs but does not by itself prove which are current KNTT-Core.
The current CĐ22 lesson claims grades 7–9 and contains an old hard 7/10 completion gate. Both need careful follow-up after source review.

evidence.source: exact KNTT grade/book chapter lesson or official curriculum clause

constraints: Do not assume Topic 22 is THCS Core or that all its skills are THPT: classify each skill individually from the actual curriculum/SGK.
Differentiate arithmetic prior knowledge (e.g. simple mean) from the formal statistics curriculum requirement.
Do not use existing bank presence or website grade banner as proof of KNTT Core.
When documentary support is missing, return UNRESOLVED and specify what exact source/page is needed.
No new score/readiness labels and no changes to repo. Recommend the smallest correct next authoring batch only after evidence review.
Do not silently change Golden Template or relabel questions without evidence. Apply direct-language math editorial guide.
If grade-10 placement is verified, classify THPT-Bridge rather than claim grade-6–9 Core; preserve useful learner practice in a non-gating pathway.
